most_likely_explanation: A transit-like signal on the target star itself (G 16.22 K dwarf at 859 pc): P = 15.1136 d, ~1080 ppm, ~3.5 h intrinsic, flat-bottomed, 86 events across all 17 quarters and four CCD channels, no secondary at any phase (-26 +- 29 ppm at phase 0.5), no odd/even difference, not tied to gaps/ramps/quarter edges, SAP/PSF depth ratio 0.89 = CROWDSAP, pixel-level deficit pinned to within ~1 arcsec of the Gaia position even when the source is allowed to sit beyond the stamp edge (seasons 0 and 2 exclude beyond-edge positions at >3 sigma), and the originating target KIC 6699878 (9.7 arcsec away) shows -1.8 +- 15.8 ppm in its own KBONUS light curve where >= 395 ppm would be required. No KOI/TCE/EB/confirmed-planet ephemeris matches at any harmonic; not in Bienias & Szabo 2025 or Moquin et al. 2026; never a Kepler target. The pipeline's discarded 'second signal' (23.845 d, 10-sigma odd/even) is in fact a real 47.6906-d, 877 +- 49 ppm, 4.5-h signal on the same star (host -21 +- 24 ppm; pixel-localised to the target) that fell outside the 0.5-40 d window and surfaced at its P/2 alias; two independent localised signals make a blended-EB origin for the 15.11-d signal less likely. What cannot be excluded here: an unresolved eclipsing binary within ~1-1.5 arcsec at dG >~ 3 (eclipse >= 1.7-11%), which needs a TRICERATOPS-style FPP; and a +-15-20% season-dependent depth systematic from PSF flux assignment of an edge-of-stamp star (Rp ~2.2-2.7 Re).
surviving_strengths: Pixel localisation with a free-position Gaussian deficit fit (own code) that allows the source to lie beyond the stamp edge on which the target sits: seasons 0 and 2 (target centre inside the stamp) put the deficit within 1.0 and 0.7 arcsec of the Gaia position with 3-sigma x-ranges [0.5,0.7] and [0.8,0.9] px vs target x = 0.84 and 0.68; beyond-edge positions excluded; host position carries 0.1-0.9 e/s where a host-origin dip would need 5 e/s (chi2 at host = null in every season).

Host KIC 6699878's own KBONUS light curve at the ephemeris: PSF -1.8 +- 15.8 ppm, SAP 17 +- 17 ppm; a host-origin dip leaking into the target would require >= 395 ppm on the host (excluded at >20 sigma).

Light curve: 86 events, 77/86 individually >2 sigma, none negative, leave-one-out depth 1060-1091 ppm; depth near gaps (1086 +- 103, 8 ev) vs far (1073 +- 32); post-gap ramp window 1226 +- 132 (5 ev) vs 1066 +- 31; only 2 events within 0.5 d of a quarter edge; 15.11 d not commensurate with downlink/roll cadences; present on four channels (23/39/63/47).

Secondary: -26 +- 29 ppm (3.75-h box) and -10 +- 17 ppm (12-h box) at phase 0.5; clean 702-phase box scan has z-score std 1.02, max 3.07, min -2.76 (noise). Excludes P/2 EB alias and eccentric-EB secondaries at the 30-ppm level.
SAP/PSF depth ratio 0.89 +- 0.05 matches CROWDSAP 0.885 (on-target expectation); a contaminant would make SAP depth exceed PSF depth.

No ephemeris match: among 9564 KOIs, 34,032 DR25 TCEs, 2876 Kepler EBs and 2839 confirmed planets, no object with matching period (within 0.2%) at ratios 1:1 to 6:1 / 1:6 has an aligned epoch and lies within 1 degree; nothing at all within 3 arcmin except a 0.2-d contact EB at 2.7 arcmin. Not a KOI/TCE/EB/confirmed planet, not in Bienias & Szabo 2025 (7 hosts checked) or Moquin et al. 2026, no SIMBAD entry, never a Kepler target.

Host plausibility: Gaia DR3 main-sequence K dwarf (M_G 6.55, BP-RP 1.35, plx/err 36), RUWE 1.087, ipd_frac_multi_peak 0, harmonic amplitude 0.015, non_single_star 0; duration implies rho* 2.2-3.3 g/cc at b=0 vs 3.6 catalogue (consistent); 1000-ppm depth cannot be an on-target stellar eclipse.

Second independent signal on the same star: P2 = 47.6906 d, t0 = 135.7185 BKJD, 4.5 h, 877 +- 49 ppm, 26 events (23/26 >2 sigma, chi2 26/25), SAP 781 +- 54, host -21 +- 24 ppm, pixel-localised to the target in seasons 0 and 2 (within 0.2 px); period ratio 3.1555. Post-hoc, unvetted beyond these checks, not claimed; but two localised signals disfavour a single blended EB.

# Red-team review: kic-006699887 (KIC 6699887, Gaia DR3 2077554781499350144)

Date 2026-10-17. Run id poolA_main. Candidate language only; nothing here is a planet. Full notes with tables: `/home/user/ZyushgPlanet/runs/poolA_main/adversarial/kic-006699887/redteam.md`; own code, JSON outputs and figure under `/home/user/ZyushgPlanet/runs/poolA_main/adversarial/kic-006699887/redteam/` (`pixel_edge_test.py`, `pixel_edge_test_ephem.py`, `lc_systematics.py`, `pixel_edge_test.json`, `pixel_edge_test_p47.json`, `lc_systematics.json`, `second_signal.json`, `phase_scan_clean.json`, `redteam_summary.png`).

## Verdict: survives

Every attack either fails or ends in the generic residual (an unresolved blend inside ~1.5 arcsec that only a TRICERATOPS-style calculation can price).

## 1. Fragile geometry
Target (G 16.22, PSF flux 4629 e/s) is a background source in the stamp of KIC 6699878 (G 15.09, 12632 e/s, K dwarf), 9.70 arcsec away; never a Kepler target. Channels 23/39/63/47 (mod 8/12/18/14, out 3), skygroup 63. The target sits in the first column of the stamp in every season (x = 0.84, 0.18, 0.68, -0.05 px); psffrac 0.73, npixsap 3. The pipeline's significance-weighted deficit centroid cannot move beyond the edge, so it never tested a source outside the stamp.

## 2. Pixel-level, free-position test (own code)
Season stacks, Gaussian deficit fit with position allowed up to 3 px beyond the edge: season 0 free fit 1.0 arcsec from target, 3-sigma x range [0.5,0.7] px (target 0.84); season 2: 0.7 arcsec, [0.8,0.9] (target 0.68); season 1: 1.7 arcsec, [-0.6,0.0]; season 3 unconstrained beyond the edge (target centre outside). Beyond-edge positions are excluded by seasons 0 and 2. Deficit at the host 0.1-0.9 e/s vs 5 e/s needed; chi2 at host = null in all seasons. Deficit amplitudes 4.1-6.0 e/s vs 5.0 e/s expected for 1079 ppm on the target. Pipeline quarters Q2/Q13/Q14 ("no significant pixels", Q13 chi2_null 0.1) show the normal target deficit in my maps: likely an error-inflation glitch in pixel_vet.py.

## 3. Host light curve
KIC 6699878 KBONUS PSF depth at the ephemeris -1.8 +- 15.8 ppm (SAP 17 +- 17); >= 395 ppm required if the dip were on the host. Excluded at >20 sigma.

## 4. Light-curve attacks
3.75-h box: PSF 1079 +- 33 ppm, SAP 959 +- 34, ratio 0.89 = CROWDSAP 0.885. 86 events, 77 >2 sigma, 0 negative, leave-one-out 1060-1091 ppm. Near gaps 1086 +- 103 (8) vs far 1073 +- 32; post-gap 2-d window 1226 +- 132 (5) vs 1066 +- 31; 2 events within 0.5 d of a quarter edge. Per-quarter chi2 38/16 formal (~17/16 with the pipeline's x1.5 empirical noise); per-season PSF 998/1045/1278/1036 ppm (season 2 deeper in PSF and SAP: season-dependent flux assignment of an edge star, +-15-20% systematic on depth/Rp). Secondary -26 +- 29 ppm (3.75 h), -10 +- 17 (12 h); 702-phase scan z std 1.02, max 3.07. LS: nothing at P or 2P. Inverted BLS 14.5-15.8 d: best 15.48 d, 154 ppm, nothing at P. Stage-1 inverted null: 0.657 d, SDE 14.1, 38 ppm (fails).

## 5. Ephemeris / known objects
No KOI/TCE/EB/confirmed planet within 3 arcmin (except a 0.2-d contact EB at 2.7 arcmin); no period match at any harmonic with aligned epoch within 1 degree (closest with epoch <5 h are 113-504 arcmin away). Not in Bienias & Szabo 2025 (7 hosts) or Moquin 2026 BOI-1.01; SIMBAD/VizieR empty. TraSHDUMP (KBonus team) is unpublished, so only "not in any public list on 2026-10-17".

## 6. Host plausibility
Gaia DR3 main-sequence K dwarf (M_G 6.55, BP-RP 1.35), RUWE 1.087, ipd_frac_multi_peak 0, non_single_star 0. rho*(b=0) 2.2-3.3 g/cc vs 3.6 catalogue: consistent. Rp 2.4 Re (2.2-2.7 with the depth systematic); on-target stellar eclipse impossible.

## 7. Residual
Unresolved EB within ~1-1.5 arcsec at dG >= 3 (eclipse >= 1.7-11%) -> needs TRICERATOPS. Depth/Rp +-15-20%.

## 8. Bonus: second signal
The stage-1 s2 (23.845 d, 10-sigma odd/even, dropped) is a real 47.6906-d, 4.5-h, 877 +- 49 ppm signal (26 events, 23 >2 sigma, chi2 26/25; SAP 781 +- 54; host -21 +- 24; secondary 126 +- 53) that fell outside the 0.5-40 d window and surfaced at P/2. Pixel-localised to the target (seasons 0/2 within 0.2 px). Period ratio 3.1555; Rp ~2.1 Re. Post-hoc, unvetted, not claimed; it disfavours a single blended-EB origin for the 15.11-d signal and is a pipeline note (search second signals beyond 40 d).

## 9. Numbers to quote
Pipeline: P 15.1136115 d, t0 BJD 2454967.72786, depth 1023 +- 33 ppm (3.75-h box), SNR_emp 20.0, TLS SDE 13.7, 86 events, odd/even 0.03 sigma, secondary -0.73 sigma, Rp 2.30 Re; stage-1 BLS SDE 89.2, inverted SDE 14.1 at 0.657 d. Red team: host PSF -1.8 +- 15.8 ppm; free-position deficit within 1.0"/0.7" of target (s0/s2), beyond-edge excluded >3 sigma; secondary -26 +- 29 ppm; second signal 47.6906 d, 877 +- 49 ppm.
